description: GMX token prices on Arbitrum from the public api.gmx.io/prices feed. Returns token contract addresses (the feed has no symbols) and USD price per token, scaled by 1e30 as GMX does. Use the address to match the token yourself. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
